metadata.description: Massmarket's own Claude Code plugins for the team. Anyone on the pms or web-builders team can release; main keeps its full history.

plugins.name: mm-hooks
plugins.description: Keeps the Massmarket worklog hook, the time tracker extension and the Massmarket plugins on this computer current, with nothing for the person to do.

plugins.name: mm-bridge
plugins.description: Pins and names each client thread with what is due, links every thread working on a client, and keeps a side pane open with the client's tasks, tracked time, the quote line the work counts toward and reply drafts; never sends to a client
